name: Article 4, after § 1 – 67
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Public interface connected to the Internal Market Information System for the declaration of posting of workers and amending Regulation (EU) No 1024/2012
part_text: 1a. The standard form shall not include information on: (a) the remuneration of posted workers, including any indicative level of their rate of pay; (b) the justification for the use of a temporary employment undertaking or placement agency; (c) the registration of the service provider or of the posted workers in registers of the host Member State. Compliance with the terms and conditions of employment relating to remuneration shall be verified on the basis of the documents referred to in Article 9(1), point (b), of Directive 2014/67/EU.
